title: Patch regression report
description: The auditable outcome of the ADR-0014 patch-regression check for one targeted revision. A patch may pass only when the targeted issue materially improved or resolved, the targeted dimension did not worsen, every dimension the pinned policy gates is present in BOTH the pre-patch and post-patch scorecards, no protected dimension regressed beyond the pinned tolerance, no new blocking/major issue appeared, and every applicable protection (output language, contract, continuity, knowledge, genre, voice/register, prose, structure) still passes. A failed report blocks approval and therefore canon acceptance.

manuscript_version_id.description: The revised (post-patch) version this report judges.

parent_version_id.description: The pre-patch version the comparison is against.

tolerance_points.description: policy.revision.regression_tolerance_points. An absent policy value means zero, never unlimited.

deltas.description: Per-dimension movement across every dimension the pinned policy gates and both scorecards carry.

regressions.description: Protected (non-targeted) dimensions that fell by more than the tolerance.

missing_gated_dimensions.description: Dimensions the pinned policy gates that neither scorecard carries, in sorted order. Required policy-gated evidence: a non-empty list fails the report with `gated_dimension_missing`, so an unwired judge can never read as a silent pass. Kept for auditability of which gate was unavailable.

dropped_dimensions.description: Dimensions the parent scorecard carried that the revised scorecard no longer carries. A patch may not pass by deleting its own evidence.

resolved.description: Every blocking/major issue the patch targeted is no longer open on the revised version.

materially_improved.description: The targeted issues resolved, or the targeted dimension's score rose.

protections.description: Applicable fail-closed protections and their outcome. A protection whose evidence is absent is reported, never assumed to pass.

new_issue_kinds.description: Issue kinds present at blocking/major on the revised version that the parent did not carry.

failures.description: Every reason the patch did not pass. Empty exactly when `passed` is true.
